column3: Close to the Hebrew; “this harm” is rendered “this doom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you sinned” is rendered “you people have sinned.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will set my eye on you” is rendered “I will look after you,” and “refrain” “remain here.”

The opening Hebrew, “and still he would not return — return!”, is unclear; NKJV renders “while Jeremiah had not yet gone back, Nebuzaradan said,” supplying the names. “Appointed” is rendered “made governor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “appointed Gedaliah over the land” is rendered “made Gedaliah … governor in the land,” and “the open country” “the fields.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to stand before the Chaldeans” is rendered “serve the Chaldeans.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to strike you, your life” is rendered “to murder you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “strike you, your life” is rendered “murder you.”
